facts.fact: OSIRIS, citing Vie publique, reports Law No. 2026-20 on digital security, published in the Journal officiel, sets up a National Cybersecurity Authority.

OSIRIS, citing Vie publique, reports that Law No. 2026-20 on digital security, published in the Journal officiel, provides for identifying critical infrastructure in energy, health, telecommunications, financial services and administration, and binds its operators to notify cyber incidents within 24 hours.
